metadata.name: Windows virtual machine
metadata.description: Deploys a Windows VM, its private NIC and OS disk, plus optional extensions. Requires an existing subnet and image; domain join and AVD registration are caller-supplied customizations.
Extension resource name. Must be unique within the VM.
Extension handler publisher.
Extension type name.
Major.minor version string. E.g. "1.3". autoUpgradeMinorVersion applies to the minor part.
Change this value to force the extension to re-run on an already-deployed VM.
Extension-specific public settings object.
Extension-specific protected (secret) settings. Not logged or returned in ARM responses.
Optional. Names of extensions in the same array that must be provisioned before this one.
VM extension handler, upgrade options and public or protected settings.
Required. Local administrator password for the Windows VM, passed as a secure value.
Required. Local administrator account name for the Windows VM.
Availability set resource ID. Empty = no availability set.
Optional. Enable boot diagnostics with managed storage account.
Optional. Custom image resource ID. Overrides imagePublisher/imageOffer/imageSku when provided.
Disk access resource ID for restricting disk network access.
Optional. The disk controller type. When empty, Azure selects automatically based on the VM SKU.
Disk encryption set resource ID for customer-managed key encryption.
Optional. Enable accelerated networking on the NIC; the consuming VM size and OS must support it.
Optional. Enable host-level VM encryption; the selected VM size must support it.
VM extensions to install.
Optional. Enable VM hibernation capability; the selected VM size and image must support it.
Optional. Marketplace image offer, used only when no custom image resource ID is supplied.
Optional. Marketplace image publisher, used only when no custom image resource ID is supplied.
Optional. Marketplace image SKU; the latest version is used when no custom image resource ID is supplied.
Optional. Windows Server license type for Azure Hybrid Benefit.
Optional. Azure region for the windows virtual machine; defaults to the deployment resource group region.
Required. Name of the windows virtual machine to deploy.
Optional. NIC delete option when the VM is deleted.
Required. Name of the private network interface created for the VM.
Optional. Private IP address for the VM NIC; used only when nicPrivateIPAllocationMethod is Static.
Optional. Private IP allocation method for the VM NIC.
Optional. OS disk delete option when the VM is deleted.
Required. Name of the managed OS disk created from the selected image.
OS disk size in GB. 0 uses the image default.
Optional. Storage account type for the managed OS disk; must be supported by the selected VM and image.
Optional. Enable Secure Boot when the VM security type is not Standard.
Optional. VM security model; the image and VM size must support the selected model.
Required. Resource ID of the existing subnet used by the VM NIC.
Optional. Enable system-assigned managed identity in addition to any user-assigned identities.
Optional. Tags applied to the windows virtual machine.
User-assigned managed identity resource IDs.
Optional. Azure VM size; must support the selected image, security settings and networking capabilities.
Optional. Enable the virtual TPM when the VM security type is not Standard.

metadata.description: Serializes artifact customization Run Commands on an existing VM, resolving relative blob names against the supplied container URI and forwarding an attached identity client ID.
Unique name for the customization.
Artifact blob path relative to the configured container, or a full HTTP or HTTPS URI.

Required. Base URI of the existing artifact container used to resolve relative customization blob names.
Required. Ordered objects with name and blobNameOrUri, plus optional arguments and comma-separated successExitCodes; relative blob names use artifactsContainerUri.
Optional. Azure region for the resources deployed by this module.
Required. Client ID of the identity attached to the VM and authorized for the requested operations.
Required. Name of the existing VM in the deployment resource group.
